failure_types.title: Subject drift
failure_types.description: The sample no longer reads as the intended product, product family, or shot role.
observable_signals: extra product variants dominate the frame
recommended_corrections: lock the product type before styling
repeat single-product identity anchors in the prompt
remove alternative-product language from the shot brief

failure_types.title: Material plasticity
failure_types.description: The material reads as cheap, toy-like, over-smoothed, melted, or physically implausible.
recommended_corrections: control glow intensity and diffuser edge readability

failure_types.title: Composition imbalance
failure_types.description: Framing, scale, foreground, or negative space prevents the product from reading as the clear commercial subject.
recommended_corrections: reserve clean space around handle and base

failure_types.title: Detail or anatomy artifact
failure_types.description: Important product details are warped, fused, missing, or synthetically unstable.

failure_types.title: Commercial unfitness
failure_types.description: The sample is not usable as review evidence for a product, campaign, or SKU route.
recommended_corrections: remove readable brand text and watermark risks
reset the shot route before retry
split SKU and scene-hero routes when they conflict
